title: Sefton Delmer's Black Radio
titleEs: Las radios negras de Sefton Delmer
excerpt: British black propaganda stations run by Sefton Delmer that posed as German broadcasters, mixing real news with invented Nazi scandal to undermine morale from 1941 to 1945.
excerptEs: Emisoras británicas de propaganda negra dirigidas por Sefton Delmer que se hacían pasar por alemanas y mezclaban noticias reales con escándalos nazis inventados para minar la moral (1941-1945).

sources.title: The National Archives (UK), FO 898: Political Warfare Executive papers (series description and administrative history)
The National Archives (UK), KV 2/2586: Security Service file on Dennis Sefton Delmer
